To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

requesting BWC footage from the 3/18/2026 shooting of 25 year old Sean Barry at Webb Park in Weymouth MA. Officer Jack Brown's BWC footage and any other officer present who may have activated their BWC. I am seeking 5 minutes prior to the shooting, the shooting,  and 10 minutes after the shooting

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by the recommendations of the Massachusetts Supervisor of Public Records. The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

I expect the request to be filled in an accessible format, including for screen readers, which provide text-to-speech for persons unable to read print. Files that are not accessible to screen readers include, for example, .pdf image files as well as physical documents.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Annemarie Grant

title: Cambridge Upper School Suspension and Discipline Data by School, Offense and Student Group (2022-23 to Present)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Records sufficient to show, for each of the following schools: Amigos School (grades 6 to 8), Cambridge Street Upper School, Darby Vassall Upper School (formerly Vassal Lane Upper School), Putnam Avenue Upper School, and Rindge Avenue Upper School, for each school year from 2022-23 to the date this request is processed:

The number of in-school suspensions, out-of-school suspensions, emergency removals, and expulsions issued, and the total number of school days missed due to each.
The number of unique students who received each type of discipline.
The above broken down by offense category as reported to DESE in the School Safety Discipline Report (SSDR), including bullying, sexual harassment, sexual assault, physical attack, and threat of physical attack.
The above broken down by student race/ethnicity, disability status, English learner status, low-income status, and sex.
Any records of students sent home early, removed from class, or excluded from school for disciplinary reasons that were not recorded as a suspension or emergency removal.
The district’s SSDR submissions to DESE for each of these schools for the years above.

I am not requesting the names of any students. Please redact student-identifying information under FERPA and G.L. c. 4, §7(26)(a), releasing all reasonably segregable portions and citing the specific exemption for each redaction. Aggregate counts are acceptable and preferred.

Please provide records in electronic format, with spreadsheets in native format (.xlsx or .csv). If fees will exceed $50, please provide an itemized estimate before proceeding. I request a fee waiver, as these records concern student safety and the public interest in how Cambridge Public Schools uses exclusionary discipline.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by the recommendations of the Massachusetts Supervisor of Public Records. The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

I expect the request to be filled in an accessible format, including for screen readers, which provide text-to-speech for persons unable to read print. Files that are not accessible to screen readers include, for example, .pdf image files as well as physical documents.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robert Kristoff

title: Louisiana Public Records Law Request: OPCD MCIU Dispatch Agreements and Protocols (replaces #26-16490)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Louisiana Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

This request replaces #26-16490, which was closed on October 7, 2026 by the City Law Department with the statement that “the City does not have records responsive to your request.” The Orleans Parish Communication District is a separate public body from the City, so I ask that OPCD’s own records custodian search OPCD’s records. The MCIU unit identifiers are being requested separately under #26-1022.

I request the following records held by the Orleans Parish Communication District concerning the Mobile Crisis Intervention Unit (MCIU):

Any memorandum of understanding, intergovernmental agreement, or operating protocol between OPCD and the City of New Orleans or Resources for Human Development governing MCIU dispatch.
Dispatch protocols, call-triage criteria, or standard operating procedures governing when MCIU is dispatched.
Any roster, contact list, or personnel list for MCIU provided to or maintained by OPCD for dispatch purposes.
Any list of MCIU personnel authorized to access or be assigned within the CAD system.
Any training records or system-access training rosters for MCIU personnel on OPCD systems.

If any record contains exempt material, please redact only that portion, cite the exemption, and release the rest. If OPCD holds none of these records, please say so in writing for each item. If you need proof of identity under La. R.S. 44:32, please tell me what form you require.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Filed Requests
